qrCodeTracking.heading: Track QR Code Performance in Offline Campaigns
qrCodeTracking.subheading: The Best Solution for Generating Thousands of QR Codes or eBusiness Cards
qrCodeTracking.paragraph1: Connect offline marketing with digital engagement. With ZM QR Code Services, you can create static QR codes that direct users from printed materials like brochures, posters, or flyers straight to your website or landing page—making the offline-to-online transition seamless.
qrCodeTracking.paragraph2: Even with static QR codes, you can still compare engagement across various campaigns. By using different static QR codes for each printed asset or distribution channel, you can monitor which materials are drawing the most attention through scan volume.
qrCodeTracking.paragraph3: Organize your campaigns with ease using folders and labels, and gain insights by manually comparing which QR version generates more interaction—helpful for A/B testing between print formats or audience segments.
qrCodeTracking.paragraph4: Track scan volume and estimate success rates by evaluating the actions users take after scanning—like visiting your site, viewing a product, or contacting you.
qrCodeTracking.paragraph5: Start using our free Static QR Code Generator today—no sign-up required to begin creating beautiful, branded QR codes for your print campaigns.

faqs.question: What is the refund policy?
faqs.answer: You can request a refund within 7 days of purchase if the service hasn't been used or activated.

faqs.question: How do I update my profile?
faqs.answer: Log in to your dashboard, go to 'My Profile', and click 'Edit' to update your personal information.

faqs.question: How can I contact support?
faqs.answer: You can contact support through the 'Contact Us' page or by emailing support@zmqrcode.com.

faqs.question: After a QR code is generated, is it possible to add other content to it?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can update or add additional content through the dynamic QR code management section.

faqs.question: Using a single mobile number or email, how many QR codes can we generate?
faqs.answer: You can generate unlimited QR codes using a single account, depending on your subscription plan.

faqs.question: Can we generate a QR code without a password?
faqs.answer: Yes, password protection is optional. You can create public QR codes without a password.

faqs.question: Can we download an invoice through a QR code?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can link invoices to your QR code for users to download them instantly.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support for QR codes?
faqs.answer: Reach out via live chat, email, or through the help section on our website.

faqs.question: Can I make payments using a QR code?
faqs.answer: Yes, our platform supports payment-enabled QR codes using UPI and other gateways.

faqs.question: Can I delete my saved data on a QR code?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can delete or update the content linked to any dynamic QR code via your dashboard.

faqs.question: Will I get a refund if I cancel my subscription?
faqs.answer: Refunds are provided based on our refund policy. Generally, cancellations within 7 days are eligible.

faqs.question: If I delete my QR account, will my data get erased?
faqs.answer: Yes, once your account is deleted, all your QR codes and related data will be permanently removed.

faqs.question: After the plan expires, what should I do?
faqs.answer: You can renew your plan to retain full access. Otherwise, your QR codes may be deactivated.

faqs.question: What is the validity of a QR code?
faqs.answer: Static QR codes are valid permanently. Dynamic codes are valid as long as your subscription is active.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to renew my QR code annually?
faqs.answer: Pricing varies by plan. Visit our pricing page to see the latest renewal charges.

faqs.question: Will I lose my data if I don’t renew my QR code?
faqs.answer: Yes, dynamic QR code data will become inaccessible unless the plan is renewed within the grace period.

faqs.question: Can I use my QR code for multiple services?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can link your QR code to multiple services or update the destination anytime for dynamic codes.

faqs.question: How do I create an account with ZMQRCode Services?
faqs.answer: Click on 'Sign Up' on the homepage and fill in the required details to create your account.

faqs.question: What information do I need to provide to create an account?
faqs.answer: You'll need a valid email address, mobile number, and a strong password.

faqs.question: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
faqs.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and follow the instructions sent to your email.

faqs.question: How do I update my account information?
faqs.answer: Log in to your account and navigate to the 'Settings' section to update your details.

faqs.question: Can I change my email address associated with my account?
faqs.answer: Yes, go to 'Account Settings' and update your email. A verification email will be sent.
